name: security-headers
description: Scan a website with securityheaders.com (plus a local fallback grader), explain every missing or weak HTTP security header, and produce platform-specific fixes for AWS (CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway, Amplify, S3, Elastic Beanstalk) and Cloudflare (Transform Rules, Managed Transforms, HSTS, Workers). Then re-scan to verify the grade improved.
